isolation.bootstrap_source:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

$root = __DIR__ . '/repo';
require $root . '/tests/bootstrap.php';

$classes = [
    Componenta\DI\ProxyFactory::class => 'src/ProxyFactory.php',
    Componenta\DI\Container::class => 'src/Container.php',
    Componenta\DI\ContainerFactory::class => 'src/ContainerFactory.php',
    Componenta\DI\Exception\ResolutionException::class => 'src/Exception/ResolutionException.php',
    Componenta\DI\Tests\Support\ContainerBuilder::class => 'tests/Support/ContainerBuilder.php',
];
$observed = ['php' => PHP_VERSION, 'root' => $root, 'classes' => [], 'functions' => []];
foreach ($classes as $class => $relative) {
    $path = (new ReflectionClass($class))->getFileName();
    if ($path === false || realpath($path) !== realpath($root . '/' . $relative)) {
        throw new LogicException('Unexpected loaded class origin: ' . $class);
    }
    $observed['classes'][$class] = ['path' => $path, 'sha256' => hash_file('sha256', $path)];
}
foreach (get_defined_functions()['user'] as $function) {
    if (!str_starts_with($function, 'componenta\\di\\internal\\') && $function !== 'componenta\\di\\tests\\support\\container') {
        continue;
    }
    $path = (new ReflectionFunction($function))->getFileName();
    $relative = $function === 'componenta\\di\\tests\\support\\container' ? 'tests/Support/functions.php' : 'src/Internal/functions.php';
    if ($path === false || realpath($path) !== realpath($root . '/' . $relative)) {
        throw new LogicException('Unexpected loaded function origin: ' . $function);
    }
    $observed['functions'][$function] = ['path' => $path, 'sha256' => hash_file('sha256', $path)];
}
if (count($observed['functions']) !== 7) {
    throw new LogicException('Expected six internal functions and the local container test helper.');
}
$destination = getenv('D1_ORIGIN_REPORT');
if ($destination === false || $destination === '') {
    throw new LogicException('Set D1_ORIGIN_REPORT for isolated verification.');
}
file_put_contents($destination, json_encode($observed, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR) . "\n");
